_comment: Add this under 'mcpServers' in your Claude Desktop / Claude Code MCP config. Uses Supabase's official MCP server via npx — no install step needed.
_notes: Project ref: found in Supabase project URL, e.g. https://abcdefgh.supabase.co -> ref is 'abcdefgh'.
Personal access token: Supabase dashboard -> Account -> Access Tokens -> Generate new token.
Once connected, you can ask Claude things like 'show me my last 10 ideas' or 'find ideas tagged fomo' directly.
For read-only safety, you can add --read-only to args if you only want Claude to query, not modify, the table.
